"""Orders due on a given UTC day."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def due_on(orders, day):
    """Return the ids of the orders whose UTC due time falls on day."""
    return [order["id"] for order in orders if datetime.fromtimestamp(order["due_ts"], timezone.utc).date() == day]

"""Download every customer page."""

PAGE_SIZE = 50


def fetch_all(fetch_page, total):
    """Return all customers. fetch_page(n) returns page n."""
    items = []
    for number in range(-(-total // PAGE_SIZE)):
        items.extend(fetch_page(number))
    return items
